assessment_objectives.objective: policies and standards facilitate the implementation of Mobile Device Management (MDM) controls.
usage restrictions are established for mobile devices.
Mobile Device Management (MDM) operations are conducted according to documented policies, standards, procedures and/or other organizational directives.
resources (e.g., people, processes, technologies, data and/or facilities) required to support Mobile Device Management (MDM) operations are identified and provided.
responsibility and authority for the performance of Mobile Device Management (MDM)-related activities are assigned to designated personnel.
personnel performing Mobile Device Management (MDM)-related activities have the skills and knowledge needed to perform their assigned duties.
